question: What was the baseline?
title: Ensemble based discriminative models for Visual Dialog Challenge 2018
answer_short: ensemble of three discriminative models with different encoders and decoders
answer_rationale: The baseline is explicitly defined as the ensemble of three discriminative models with different encoders and decoders, which achieved the best performance on the test-std split. This is stated in both Text 1 and Text 2, which describe the ensembling process and the performance of this ensemble. Text 2 also confirms that this ensemble was used for the final submission and achieved the highest scores.
